gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Exact ZIPs ran with zero invalid actions; measured import/create, reset, act latency, and RSS were within local limits.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Launch activated 120 times, early steering 106 times, and extra gas and brake zero times across 12 fresh tune cells.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Both arms finished 12/12 new tune cells; candidate median 24.27 s versus control 24.32 s, with zero collisions or damage. Track 1 was slower in three of four paired cells; held-out remains untested.
